concerns.text: The effort covariate (total complete checklists per cell‑year) is used both to adjust the definition of the target variable (first‑arrival week) – via an offset in the cumulative‑count threshold (FR‑003) – and as an independent predictor in the XGBoost model (FR‑008). Because higher observer effort directly increases the chance of early detections, the predictor is not independent of the outcome construction, creating a circular relationship that can inflate model performance without reflecting genuine environmental effects.
